8 of 10 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term

The committee discussed the findings of the recent audit related to the CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term. Tuyen Marks summarized the 158 findings and management's proposed remediation plan. The committee endorsed the plan and requested quarterly progress updates.

Motion

To approve for transformation: RESOLVED, that the Foundation Audit Committee authorizes a share repurchase program of up to $158M of the company's common stock.

Moved: Willie Pennington  •  Seconded: Tuyen Marks
Vote: 7 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Share Repurchase Program Authorization

The Share Repurchase Program Authorization was a review of the company's compliance with the Bipartisan Campaign Reform Act. The committee reviewed the company's electioneering communications and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To approve for KPIs: RESOLVED, that the Foundation Audit Committee has reviewed and discussed the quarterly financial statements with management and the independent auditors.

Moved: Benjamin Hall  •  Seconded: Ayo Shelton
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  3 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Government Affairs Update — 13 Legislation

The Government Affairs Update — 13 Legislation was a review of the company's performance against its ESG goals. Nora Nielsen reported that the company had met 158 of its 20 targets for the year. The committee discussed strategies for addressing the shortfalls.
